report:
Fresh final marker followup of meta.anchors.context_navigation. Preserved previous input/output, started fresh and checked the complete claim, three implementation associations, four ordinary tests and one TODO test. Recaptured all prior helpers: book Fixture/chapter/script-data ranges, spec BookFixture, and browser.js anchor routing/selection ranges. Compared every fragment by path/selector and both metadata collections. The only delta is an implementation_references comment in spec.rs; all claim, implementation behavior, tests, helper captures and association metadata are unchanged, with no removed fragments. I reassessed this isolated marker against the complete prior accounting below.

The three ordinary implementations cover chapter replacements, safe prose rendering and anchor-page generation. spec.rs chapter_replacements gives the definition badge its canonical id and a separate href to the generated anchor page; reference links also target that page. add_chapter_text records a distinct context_url to the defining Markdown chapter/anchor or Sage chapter/anchor: route, preserving entity ownership. Reparsing supplied rendered chapter text keeps badges correct after preprocessor prefix changes. book/anchors.rs page renders a relative context link back to that stored destination. browser.rs render_spec_markdown protects roles while rendering/rebasing their links and targets the parent book shell. Captured browser.js resolves an anchor's entity, renders that entity route and selects/highlights/scrolls the canonical marker. Thus viewing rule connections does not replace the independent definition permalink. Source inspection of this path is not live browser execution.

All four ordinary tests retain meaningful assertions. generated_anchor_pages_join_namespaces_claims_implementations_tests_and_reviews runs real preprocessing and checks both the definition-to-anchor-page href and generated-page-to-Markdown-context href. sage_anchor_links_retain_the_containing_entity_and_exact_prose checks explorer data entity identity, exact Sage context URL, formatted prose, canonical marker id, anchor-page href and _parent targeting. badges_open_rule_pages_and_keep_definition_permalinks_after_expansion verifies badge/reference destinations and definition id after injected prefix content, while asserting the independent stored Markdown context URL. sage_prose_rules_have_precise_spans_model_owners_and_cross_source_references verifies original source spans, bounded content, declaration/field/method owners and Sage context URL, grounding the return destination in the defining prose. Captured helpers construct actual source/model files and invoke production preprocessing/inventory.

The sole TODO anchor_pages_and_definition_context_links has no behavior assertions and explicitly reserves browser-driven badge-to-anchor-to-context round trips for Markdown and Sage, permalink preservation and exact-definition scrolling. Its prerequisite is interactive generated-book/browser testing that checks the resulting location and selection. Rendered-link assertions and source inspection do not discharge this deferred end-to-end coverage. There are no N/A entries. The full claim remains supported by current link/context mechanisms with that visible test deferral; the marker-only delta adds no new gap.

No source edits, formatting, tests or workspace build were performed. Executed review start/read, capture comparison and record only. No requested edits.
